## MAGENTA (P)

A predatory topological entity. It does not graze on dead dust. Instead, it
hunts the most energetic atom in the entire ecosystem and violently siphons its
life force.

```typescript
export const ATOM = () => {
  // Siphons host energy
  return (host: any) => host.drain();
};
```
